Topic.label: The Concept of Inverse Proportional Functions

Question: The function \(y=(m+1)x^{m^2-2}\) is an inverse proportional function. Find the value of \(m\).
Solution: An inverse proportional function requires the exponent to be \(-1\), so \(m^2-2=-1\), giving \(m=\pm1\). Also, \(m+1\ne0\), so \(m\ne-1\). Therefore, \(m=1\), in which case \(y=2/x\).
